text:
nina: quick Q: autofallback is firing a lot during noisy quota windows. ops wants less pages but more context when we do page. how do we balance?

ada: we should have a three-tier notify: notify (slack), escalate (pager), and quiet-mode (no notify). quiet-mode could be auto-enabled for low-impact customers for an hour.

jin: +1 but need a deterministic rule: e.g., if fallback reason == QUOTA_THROTTLE and affected_qps < 5% of route baseline, default to notify only.

tom: important: include an SLO delta in the event. if latency or error budget risk increases > threshold, always escalate.

nina: can we compute SLO delta fast? We have 1s windows for tail latency, but budget calc is slightly heavier. maybe approximate with weighted error impact.

ada: UI: show a tiny badge on route card "fallbacks: 3 (quiet)". clicking expands timeline with event snippets and a single "escalate" button.

jin: also surface whether fallback was optimistic (model variant downgrade) vs pessimistic (circuit/bail). reason_code should capture this: e.g. FALLBACK_TYPE=MODEL_DOWNGRADE / CIRCUIT.

tom: telemetry change req: add fields: reason_code, estimated_customer_impact (low/med/high), slo_delta_pct. dashboards can filter on impact.

ops-bot: notice: fallback evt_1765467955 on route `embedding-v1`. reason=QUOTA_THROTTLE. routed to `embedding-small`. estimated_customer_impact=low. sample_examples:["[scrubbed]","[scrubbed]"]

nina: ok we also want a "replayable snapshot" attached to the event so operators can run the same batch in sim. maybe include model inputs hashed and a small KV snapshot.

ada: replay snapshot sounds great but must be scrubbed by default. add a permission gate: only SRE + oncall can access raw inputs. UI shows obfuscated examples.

jin: API thought: provide /v1/internal/fallbacks POST schema with fields: event_id, route, reason_code, alt_route, slo_delta_pct, samples[], snapshot_url. keep it small (max 1KB payload).

tom: for overrides, prefer single action: "pin primary" vs "pin fallback". pin API: { scope: "route:embedding-v1", pin_to: "primary"/"fallback", ttl: 600, operator: "nina", reason: "investigate" }

nina: should pin create an audit event that references trigger event_id? yes, do that.

ops-bot: replay-ready: created evt_1765467955.snapshot at /internal/snapshots/evt_1765467955. access=obfuscated.

ada: alert fatigue rule proposal: only page if (slo_delta_pct > 2) OR (fallback persists > 4m) OR (consec_fallbacks > 3 in 10m). otherwise slack notify.

jin: also add a cool-down: after an operator pin, suppress further pages for that route for TTL of pin. still track events in timeline.

tom: UX mini: timeline card should show compact sparkline of slo_delta and small chips for tags (quota, cache, model). clicking the chip filters the session.

nina: security: who can unpin? require "override" permission. log unpin reason mandatory.

ada: we should add a "silent remediation" opt-in where the platform tries cheaper model variants without notifying unless it impacts SLOs. ops can opt-in per team.

ops-bot: info: applying silent_remediation for team `growth` on route `chat-growth`. rule id r_1765468001.

nina: follow-ups: Jin please draft the POST event schema and sample payload. Tom, sketch the timeline card and pin modal. Ada, let's define the paging rule and permission matrix. Ops-bot, keep sending sample events to the test endpoint. reconvene tomorrow.

ops-bot: ack. will send evt_1765467955 replay and a synthetic high-impact fallback for testing.

nina: thanks all. short and actionable UX will reduce noise. :white_check_mark:
